name: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia
insider_take: This ultra-luxe adults-only sanctuary sits on Mallorca's pristine Playa de Muro, where powder-soft sands meet crystal-clear Mediterranean waters in one of the island's most exclusive enclaves.
whats_special: Villa Le Blanc is the only hotel in the Balearics with a Level Red Spa by SHA Wellness, pioneering the macrobiotic wellness philosophy. The property features Spain's first overwater spa pavilions and boasts direct access to S'Albufera Natural Park, Europe's most important wetland reserve.
pro_tip: Book the signature SHA treatments during sunset hours – the overwater spa pavilions offer unobstructed views of the Mediterranean's golden hour, creating an ethereal wellness experience you won't find anywhere else in Europe.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive beach club built on stilts over the water, and a private sunset cruise to the nearby Formentor Peninsula. The property also offers helicopter transfers directly from Palma Airport – a 12-minute scenic flight over Mallorca's dramatic coastline.
pros: Luxurious adults-only resort with sophisticated atmosphere
Premium beachfront location in Balearic Islands
Exceptional fine dining restaurants and bars
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
